To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the production of hadron pairs at large transverse momenta is a consequence of collisions among quarks and gluons, that the cross section for such collisions is given by the square of the strong coupling constant times the square of the momentum transfer, and that the cross section is enhanced by the presence of an additional quark-antiquark pair in the final state.
the production of high transverse momentum particles is described by perturbative QCD and that the production of jets is described by pertur-bative QCD.

the production cross section for high transverse momentum particles in the central rapidity region is proportional to 2/3 power of the number of participating nucleons, and that the average number of particles in the jet, N, is approximately 6.5.

the study of the properties of the strong interactions, the interactions among quarks, and the interactions among gluons.
the production of hadrons and the production of jets.
